# किसान साथी (Kisan Saathi) — फसल से लेकर बिक्री तक

> Kisan Saathi (किसान साथी) is a comprehensive Agritech Progressive Web App (PWA) and Android application designed for farmers in India, with specialized baseline intelligence for Chhattisgarh (IGKV Raipur, DAC&FW, Agmarknet).

## Core Farmer Features & Services

- **🌾 एआई फसल डॉक्टर (AI Crop Doctor):** Real-time plant pathology diagnosis using multi-modal AI. Identifies diseases in Paddy, Wheat, Chickpea, Maize, Vegetable crops with statutory CIB&RC approved chemical remedies and organic solutions. Dosage normalized per 15L Knapsack spray pump.
- **🧮 खाद नाप-जोख कैलकुलेटर (Fertilizer Dosage Calculator):** Exact NPK calculation (Urea 46% N, DAP 18:46:0, MOP 60% K, Zinc 21% Zn) calibrated per acre and dismil according to IGKV Raipur agro-climatic standards and soil type (Matasi, Dorsa, Kanhar, Bhatha).
- **💰 धान उपार्जन ₹3,100 कैलकुलेटर (Paddy MSP Procurement):** Statutory calculator for Chhattisgarh Krishak Unnati Yojana (21 quintals/acre cap, ₹3,100/qtl total rate, ₹2,369/qtl MSP + ₹731/qtl DBT bonus), Jute Bardana sack estimator (2.5 bags/qtl), ₹25 reimbursement, and Token Tuhar Hath guidelines.
- **🏪 लाइव मंडी भाव (Live Mandi APMC Rates):** Real-time modal APMC market prices across all 33 districts of Chhattisgarh sourced directly from Agmarknet / OGD India.
- **⛅ कृषि मौसम व छिड़काव परामर्श (Agricultural Weather Advisory):** Micro-climatic weather alerts, rain probability, and wind speed interlocks (>15 km/h suppresses chemical spraying).
- **🗣️ बहिरा काका वॉयस असिस्टेंट (Bhaira Kaka Voice Assistant):** Natural voice interaction in Chhattisgarhi and Hindi with zero-typing touch interfaces.
